shared_elements: ram/sheep with large spiral curled horn
animal head shown with prominent eye and muzzle
fleece or hide rendered as an incised net/cross-hatched pattern
justification: Both depict a horned ram with a heavy spiral horn beside the eye and a fleece rendered as a regular incised cross-hatch or net pattern, which is a reasonably specific shared convention for the same animal. However, A is a multi-figure procession in which human figures lead a file of rams above a band of rosettes, while B shows a single isolated animal with no accompanying figures, band or scene context, so the relationships and arrangement do not correspond.
